mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sale_item (sale_id, medicine_id, quantity, unit_price, subtotal_price) VALUES (#{saleId}, #{medicineId}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{subtotalPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT sale_id AS saleId, user_id AS userId, total_price AS totalPrice, sale_time AS saleTime FROM sale WHERE sale_id = #{saleId}

SELECT si.sale_item_id AS saleItemId, si.medicine_id AS medicineId, m.name AS medicineName, si.quantity, si.unit_price AS unitPrice, si.subtotal_price AS subtotalPrice FROM sale_item si JOIN medicine m ON si.medicine_id = m.medicine_id WHERE si.sale_id = #{saleId}
SELECT sale_id AS saleId, user_id AS userId, total_price AS totalPrice, sale_time AS saleTime FROM sale ORDER BY sale_time DESC
